costume.name: Labyrinth Faun
costume.description: Curled horns rise above leafy green layers, brown trousers and leather bracers for a guardian of a hidden woodland maze.
costume.alt: Curled brown ram horns, leafy green tunic, brown utility trousers, brown leather forearm bracers and lace-up boots

pieces.name: Curled woodland horns
pieces.styleNotes: Brown ram horns are the closest match. The smaller woodland horns and gold floral ram headband change the horn size or finish.

matches.reason: Lightweight curled ram horns make the faun silhouette. Horns only.
Horns attached with elastic string, ages 14+. Smaller woodland horns replace the large curled ram form.
Gold floral ram headband, one size fits most adults, ages 15+. Metallic alternative rather than brown horns.

pieces.name: Leaf-green top or tunic
pieces.styleNotes: Leaf-shaped green garments create the woodland torso. Options include a halter top, short dress and fuller fairy costume; wear with the separate brown trousers. Any bundled accessories are extras.

matches.reason: Green cotton/spandex fitted mini dress with overlapping pointed leaf-style layers and web-like vein seams. Merchant feed confirms Green XS/S/M/L/XL/XXL/3XL at $58. Includes dress only. US shipping policy lists 3–7 business days processing plus 8–15 business days standard transit; custom production can take longer.

Primary merchant page lists USD $38.99, selectable S/M/L and an active Buy control. Green 100% rayon satin halter tunic with embroidery, back elastic and tie, adjustable shoulder straps and uneven pointed hem, 22–28 inches depending on size. This is a simple green tunic approximation: no sewn leaf panels, layered organza or vine belt. Includes top only; wear over the separate brown trousers.

Green corseted leaf-motif dress top with asymmetrical pointed hem, spandex base, chiffon sleeves, mesh panels and coated fabric. Includes dress top, two detachable chiffon sleeves, choker, two shoulder chains and decorative front flower. Merchant feed confirms S/M/L/XL at $275. Page offers worldwide shipping and estimates 10–20 business days; processing time is not separately confirmed.

pieces.name: Brown utility trousers
pieces.styleNotes: Brown cargo trousers create the woodland base beneath the leafy top. Pockets and fabric shades differ; separate belts are not included.

matches.reason: Vintage Brown, 97% cotton/3% spandex cargo trousers with waist adjusters and visible modern pocket branding. S–2XL available at $74.99; 3XL sold out. Brown non-stretch 100% cotton military-inspired cargo pants, extra lower-leg pocket, concealed snap and zip fly. Waist labels 28–38 in stock at $195; 40 sold out. Merchant says processing within 24–48 hours; no belt included.

pieces.name: Brown forearm bracers
